title: Izmir Urban Resilience Capacity Atlas
subtitle: 30 districts: population, transit, health, markets and emergency capacity
description:
A district-level public-interest dataset for Izmir, Turkiye combining official population, public transport, hospitals, street markets and emergency assembly areas into one transparent capacity matrix.

The package contains raw source-record counts and population-normalized context for all 30 districts. It intentionally publishes no composite resilience, quality, safety, livability or investment ranking.

Source rights are mixed: Izmir Metropolitan Municipality inputs retain CC BY 4.0 attribution requirements, while TUIK/TurkStat ADNKS fields are reused under the attribution-based reuse statement in the TUIK Legal Notice. Kaggle license metadata is therefore Other (specified in description).

Important limits: zero source records do not prove real-world absence. Transit distance fields are straight-line proxies from neighborhood representative points, not walking time.
